SELECT l.* FROM plm_ledger l
l.deleted = 0
AND l.type = #{q.type}
AND l.owner_id = #{q.ownerId}
AND l.dept_id = #{q.deptId}
AND l.status = #{q.status}
AND (l.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR l.ledger_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR l.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%'))
AND l.ledger_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.ledgerNoLike}, '%')
AND l.occur_date >= CAST(#{q.occurStart} AS DATE)
AND l.occur_date <= CAST(#{q.occurEnd} AS DATE)
AND l.uploaded_at >= CAST(#{q.uploadStart} AS DATE)
AND l.uploaded_at < (CAST(#{q.uploadEnd} AS DATE) + INTERVAL '1 day')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plm_ledger_link k WHERE k.ledger_id = l.id AND k.deleted = 0 AND k.object_type = #{q.objectType} AND (k.object_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.objectKeyword}, '%') OR k.object_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.objectKeyword}, '%') OR k.object_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.objectKeyword}, '%')))
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM plm_ledger_link k WHERE k.ledger_id = l.id AND k.deleted = 0 AND k.object_type = #{q.objectType})
AND (l.dept_id = #{q.scopeDeptId} OR l.uploaded_by = #{q.scopeUserId})
ORDER BY
l.name l.occur_date l.uploaded_at l.status l.id
ASC DESC
